messages:
Nadia: Uploaded a new 'dense matrix' and a 'spotlight' prototype for the roles grid: https://figma.com/file/spotlight
Theo: Nice. Spotlight mode idea is great for triage — isolate a single role and dim others. But ensure the dimming maintains 3:1 contrast for readability
Iris: Agree. Also add a visible legend for density toggle: 'Compact / Comfortable / Spotlight' and keyboard shortcuts to cycle (k / ,)
Ben: Microcopy: primary action reads 'Grant access' in some screens and 'Assign role' in others. Let's standardize to 'Assign role' across org settings
Claire: Invite flow: CSV streaming if >200 rows. Show live parse with incremental invalid row counts and option to pause parsing
Nadia: For SR users announce parsing batches via aria-live: 'Parsed 200 rows, 5 invalid' after each batch
Theo: SSO policy granularity: propose three states: Off / Enforced for Admins / Enforced org-wide. Label visually as 'SSO enforcement: Org / Admins / Off'
Iris: Important: for screen readers don't use On/Off. Use explicit text and ensure aria-describedby links to provider settings
Ben: Audit navigation: add a timeline scrub control in the sidepanel so you can drag to see changes over time for a role
Claire: Timeline scrub should update the list and also highlight the affected permission chips in the matrix
Nadia: Tiny accessibility nit: when matrix rows collapse in compact mode focus outlines vanish in Firefox. Likely due to outline: none on collapsed state
Theo: Filed ENG-14009 for the focus outline regression and added repro steps
Iris: Keyboard flows: when opening spotlight, trap focus in the spotlight header and let arrow keys move through permissions. Esc closes and returns focus to original role row
Ben: Invite copy: if a single email is parsed show 'Send invitation' else 'Send invitations' in CTA. Also confirmation should show count
Claire: UX-bot: Checklist updated: density-toggle, spotlight-mode-a11y, csv-stream-aria, sso-granularity, audit-timeline-scrub
Nadia: Action items: Iris to add aria notes and shortcuts in Figma, Theo to spec SSO labels and confirmation modal, Ben to align microcopy, Claire to prototype CSV streaming UX. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
